newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude Medical names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude Medical names chief financial officer.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said Friday it named Robert Munzenrider vice president, finance and chief financial officer, effective August 4, 1997.
Munzenrider will report to Ronald Matricaria, chairman, president and chief executive officer.
Munzenrider succeeds Terry Shepherd, who has been acting chief financial officer following the departure of Stephen Wilson in May. Wilson left to become chief financial of Computer Motion Inc.
Shepherd remains president of St. Jude's heart valve division and president of St. Jude International.
Most recently, Munzenrider was vice president and chief financial officer of Travelers Express Co in Minneapolis, a unit of Viad Corp.
St. Jude develops, makes and distributes medical devices for the global cardiovascular market.
